newsitem.title: CHINA: China Ship takes over Shanghai Hai Xing.
newsitem.headline: China Ship takes over Shanghai Hai Xing.

text.p: Shanghai Hai Xing Shipping Co Ltd said on Monday China Shipping (Group) Co would become its controlling shareholder following a share transfer agreement between its parent company and China Shipping.

Under an agreement signed between Shanghai Hai Xing Shipping (Group) Co (SHS Group) and China Shipping on July 18, SHS Group will transfer ownership of 1.4 billion shares, or about 56.45 percent of the issued share capital, of the Hong Kong-listed H-share company to China Shipping, a company announcement said.

The agreement was conditional on approval of China's State-owned Assets Administration Bureau and the Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission waiving the requirement for China Shipping to make a general offer for all H-shares, it said.
China Shipping, a company wholly owned by China's Ministry of Communications, wholly owns the SHS Group.
Following the share transfer, China Shipping will be become the controlling shareholder of the company, it said.
